question: India’s ﬁrst gold medal at Commonwealth Games 2018 was won by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mirabai Chanu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Weightlifter Mirabai Chanu was the gold medalist for India on day one of Commonwealth Games 2018 in **the women's 48kg category__.

 __
 
• Chanu won the first gold medal for India by lifting a total of 196kg, 86kg in snatch, and 110kg in clean and jerk.
 
• She broke the CWG record in the snatch, pulling off clean lifts in all three of her attempts (80kg, 84kg, and 86kg).
 
• She broke the sporting record for the weight category; The effort also marked his personal best.
 
• She was awarded the Padma Shri by the Government of India for his contribution to sports.
 
• She was awarded the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award by the Government of India in 2018.
 
• Amanda Braddock won the bronze medal at CWG 2018.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India competed at the 2018 Commonwealth Games at Gold Coast, Australia from 4 to 15 April 2018.**
 
• It was India's 18th appearance at the Commonwealth Games.
 
 
• With 26 Gold medals and a total of 66 medals, India finished 3rd for the tournament.
 
 
 
• It was India's best position since the 2010 Commonwealth Games, which they hosted.
 
• **Weightlifter Sanjita Chanu** bagged India's second gold medal by topping the women's 53kg category.
 
• **Weightlifter Poonam Yadav **became the third woman to win gold for India by topping the women's 69kg category at the CWG 2018.
 
• **Weightlifter Venkat Rahul Ragala** has become the fourth Indian to win a gold medal in the men's 85kg category.
 
• **Weightlifter Satish Kumar Shivalingam **won India's third gold medal in the men's 77kg category.
